description: Gate 20 (network-connect-non-public-ip), x86_64 port of patch 12. The connect policy check compiles to `test al, al; je <ok>; lea rdx, [rip+anchor]; mov r8d, 0x21` where the anchor is 'network target rejected by policy' (33 bytes) and the fall-through builds the PermissionDenied error. al != 0 means reject. The Rust generic connect() is monomorphized into 4 call sites, so there are 4 identical gates. Flipping each `je` (74 XX) to `jmp` (EB XX) makes the OK path always taken, so the reject error is never built. All four sub-patches anchor to the first occurrence of the string and use distinct offsets. Length-preserving: je rel8 (2 bytes) -> jmp rel8 (2 bytes). Verified on 0.139.0: all four bytes match and the patched binary still launches.

patches.match_disasm: je <ok>  (site 1: skip reject when allow; flip to always-skip)
patches.description: site 1 of 4: je->jmp to skip the connect reject branch
